PREFACE 
This draft environmental impact statement (EIS) was jointly prepared by the Urban Mass Transportation Administration (UMTA) and the Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority (NFTA) to meet the requirements of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (NEPA). This draft EIS represents documentation of the environmental impacts of the proposed Buffalo Light Rail Rapid Transit Project.
NEPA, 42 U.S.C. S 4321, et seq. require that UMTA fully consider the environmental impacts and consequences of this proposed action prior to making a decision to proceed with the project. In order to facilitate meaningful public participation and review, as well as desirable coordination of effort between UMTA and the NFTA, it was decided by these agencies to prepare jointly this EIS.
UMTA and the NFTA have been substantially involved in the preparation and development of this draft EIS. The proposed project has been the subject of extensive discussion and review with public and local officials since 1969. Public hearings were held in April of 1972 and July of 1974 in Buffalo, New York.
The draft EIS will be circulated to various Federal, State, and local agencies and to interested organizations and individuals in accordance with the applicable guidelines and regulations adopted pursuant to NEPA. UMTA will receive comments on this draft for forty-five (45) days after the official start of circulation. A fifteen (15) day extension will be granted upon request. Circulation is planned to start on Friday, June 3. It is planned that a public hearing be conducted on the proposed project on July 14, 1977, in Buffalo, New York. UMTA and the NFTA jointly will address all substantive comments on the social, economic, and environmental issues in the final EIS.
Comments should be sent to:
Peter Benjamin, Director Office of Program Analysis Urban Mass Transportation Administration Washington, D.C. 20590
